sentences.text:
"Wherefore, the petitioners humbly pray that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to quash the entire proceedings against the Petitioners in C.C.No.1693/2016,
(PCR.No.84/2016) for the NC: 2025:KHC:25376 HC-KAR offence punishable under Sections 420 & 423 of IPC pending st on the file of 1 Addl. Civil Judge and JMFC at Nelamangala, by allowing the petition, in the interest of justice."

2. After arguing the matter for some time, learned counsel for the petitioner, on instructions,
submits that since the petitioner-accused No.2 and 3 have already filed discharge application on 22.10.2021 and the same is pending before the trial Court as on today, the present petition may be disposed of as withdrawn reserving liberty in favour of the petitioner to seek discharge and subsequently, approach this Court, if occasion arises.
3. Submission is placed on record.
The petition is disposed as withdrawn, reserving liberty in favour of the petitioner to seek discharge before the trial Court.
4. The trial Court shall consider and pass appropriate order on the discharge application filed by the petitioner in accordance with law as expeditiously as possible.
5. All rival contentions on all aspects of the matter are kept open and no opinion is expressed on the same."

4. Subsequently, though the petitioner had filed an application seeking discharge, the Trial Court appears to have advised him to withdraw the discharge application on the ground that the same can be re-filed after completion of Evidence Before Charge (EBC).

Under these circumstances, the petitioner withdrew NC: 2025:KHC:25376 HC-KAR the discharge application and has filed the present petition seeking quashment of the impugned proceedings.
5.

Though several contentions have been urged by the petitioner, having regarding to the earlier order of this Court in Crl.P.No.13052/2024 dated 22.01.2025 (supra), I deem it just and appropriate to dispose of this petition reserving liberty in favour of the petitioner to file a fresh discharge application, immediately after completion of Evidence Before Charge (EBC) before the Trial Court frames charge.
If such an application is filed by the petitioners, the Trial Court shall consider the same and pass appropriate orders, in accordance with law.
6. Subject to the aforesaid liberty reserved in favour of the petitioner, the petition stands disposed of.
